scene: You splash into the fountain basin, finding three transit docks connected below.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a tiled rooftop platform. Left, a brass clockwork train sits on cogged tracks. Center, the soaked Pacific Islander girl climbs out of a low fountain beside an anchored bubble pod. Right sits a colorful, paint-splattered tram with its boarding door wide open.
shown: A brass clockwork carousel train with turning gears waits idling on the far left.
A giant shimmering bubble lift pod floats anchored to a brass valve, center.
A vivid paint-splattered tram sits parked with open folding doors on the far right.
